entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I'm calling about my new VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for it, and it's just not working at all.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the features?

It's definitely a fault. The main reason I bought it was for the heart rate monitor, and it seems completely broken. The readings are all over the place, and it won't sync that specific data to the app. I think the unit I received is defective.

I see, that certainly sounds frustrating. A device not syncing correctly is not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your account details. Can I get your full name and email address, please?

Of course. It's Sarah Miller, and the email is s.miller@email.com. I've been a VeloFit customer for years... I just feel so let down. I really needed this money, and now I have a device that doesn't work.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your account here. We really appreciate your loyalty over the years. Okay, I see you received the VeloBand 18 days ago. Let me just check our return policy for you... one moment.

Alright, I've got it. According to our policy, items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe and the item is defective, we can absolutely process a full return for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? A full refund? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you, David. I was so worried I was going to be stuck with it.

Of course. We stand by our products. And because you're a VIP member and this has been such an inconvenience, I'm also going to add a 25% discount coupon to your account for your next purchase with us. We want to make this right.
Wow, thank you so much! That's incredibly kind. You've really turned this whole experience around for me. I appreciate it.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now. It should arrive within the next 5 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for all your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
